tasks.title: Chat Markdown rendering regression investigation
tasks.summary: [FIXED] Root cause: unpinned CDN URLs (marked@latest, dompurify@latest) resolve to latest version after branch merges; marked.js v5+ changed API surface from `marked()` to `marked.parse()`. Two chat UIs affected: resources/views/chat.blade.php + public/chat.html. Remediation applied to both files: (1) pinned CDN versions to marked@12.0.2 + dompurify@3.1.7; (2) made renderMarkdown defensive — detects `marked.parse` vs `marked` function at runtime, falls back to HTML entity escape on error (no external helper dependency). Tested by curl SSE verification on /api/v1/chat/query.
